name: FUME HOOD
desc: Premium 1500mm Industrial Fume Hood with integrated Wet Scrubber System. Engineered for safe extraction and neutralization of toxic chemical vapors, featuring a 20mm chemical-resistant Polypropylene worktop and a high-speed exhaust assembly generating ≥1000 cfm suction.
features: Fume Hood / Exhaust System integrated with Wet Scrubber Unit
High displacement rate tracking ≥ 1000 cfm suction
Cylindrical type Spray Tower Scrubber (1200mm dia x 2800mm height)
Built-in water washing and internal cleaning mechanism

specifications.System Configuration: Fume Hood / Exhaust System integrated with Wet Scrubber Unit
specifications.Fume Hood Dimensions (W x D x H): 1500 mm x 750 mm x 1600 mm robust operational structure
specifications.Base Storage Cabinet Size: 1500 mm x 700 mm x 800 mm with Adjustable Shelf integrated
specifications.Material of Construction: High-Grade Heavy Gauge Mild Steel with epoxy powder coated casing
specifications.Fume Hood Worktop (Bed): 20 mm thick chemical-resistant Polypropylene with 3-side skirting
specifications.Sash Control Mechanism: Single Vertical sliding 5mm toughened glass door with counterweights
specifications.Internal Washing & Cleaning: Built-in water washing and internal cleaning mechanism integrated
specifications.Chamber Lighting: 20 Watt LED lights enclosed in high acid-fume resistant casing
specifications.Wet Scrubber Design Type: Cylindrical type Spray Tower Scrubber (1200mm diameter x 2800mm height)
specifications.Scrubber Material Structure: Dual-Layer build: 2 mm thick PP inner layer + 3 mm thick FRP outer layer
specifications.Scrubber Extraction Flow Rate: Heavy displacement scrubber flow rate rating up to 3550 cfm
specifications.Internal Packing System: 50 mm High-Surface Area PP Pall Rings packing with PP Mist Eliminator
specifications.Water Recirculation Pump: 1 HP Single-Phase Centrifugal Pump with robust PP Impeller and casing
specifications.Recirculation Water Tank: High-Capacity 200 Liter integrated bottom water storage reservoir
specifications.Monitoring & Drainage: View Glass Water Level Indicator with 20 mm PP ball valve drain outlet
specifications.Exhaust Ducting Layout: 350 mm diameter corrosion-free FRP ducting (Up to 30 meters run)
